title: Sharp hypocoercive convergence estimates for underdamped Langevin dynamics via the modified $L^2$ method
summary: In this note, we consider the underdamped Langevin dynamics with invariant measure $μ(\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}v) \propto e^{-U(x)-|v|^2/2}\,\mathrm{d}x\,\mathrm{d}v$.
